systems.system: shared underground network for telecommunications operators
systems.owner: Commune of Plateau (Abidjan), under an agreement with KAYDAN TECHNOLOGY, which designs and deploys it
systems.tiers: Commune of Plateau only; underground galleries for all operators' cables, at the preparatory stage on 11 May 2026 with works due to start within months

note: The document states a commune's planned shared ducts for telecommunications operators serving businesses in Plateau; it does not state a connection provided to the town hall itself.
